name: What permits are needed for an accessible kitchen renovation in Daly City or Pacifica?

mainEntity.name: What permits are needed for an accessible kitchen renovation in Daly City or Pacifica?

acceptedAnswer.text: For accessible kitchen renovations in Daly City or Pacifica, permits are typically required for any structural changes, significant plumbing or electrical work, or modifications that alter the building's footprint or safety systems. This often includes moving walls, altering gas lines, or relocating sinks and appliances that require new wiring or pipes. Our team will handle the identification and application for all necessary permits with the local building departments to ensure compliance.
